How we design, communicate and pay incentives is one of the clearest levers we have for driving the right behaviour, outcomes and performance across the business, and this role turns that into a scalable, trusted system. Mews sells to hotels around the world through sales, account management, customer success and partner teams, so the plans you build shape how every one of those teams goes to market.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role in Revenue Operations, reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations, based in the UK or US. Sales, account management, customer success and partner leaders will come to you to shape how their teams are paid. Finance and People will come to you to understand what it costs and whether it’s working. You set your own priorities, align them with RevOps and leadership, and bring recommendations to the executive team rather than carrying out someone else’s design.</p> <p>As Mews grows, the way we pay our GTM teams needs to scale with it. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You'll build and own Mews Financial Services' enterprise risk framework from the ground up, reporting directly to the Chief Risk and Compliance Officer. Mews FinTech is scaling fast across payments, regulation and product, and this role exists to give the business one clear owner of enterprise-wide risk instead of risk being managed in pieces across teams. It's a genuinely greenfield opportunity to shape how a growing regulated fintech manages risk end to end, from the first framework choices onward.</p> <p>You'll own the ERM framework and risk appetite for Mews FS, act as a key contact for DNB and other regulators, and work closely with first line teams, the MLRO and the Management Board.</p> <p>As Mews FinTech grows, risk needs to scale from something managed in slices to a single enterprise-wide framework that keeps the business compliant without slowing product and commercial teams down.
